name: OLUDAMI Braids
description: OLUDAMI Braids is a braiding salon in Munster, Indiana specialising in knotless braids, box braids, boho braids, and cornrow designs — good hair, good mood, every time.

hero.title: Good hair. Good mood.
hero.subtitle: Knotless, box, and boho braids plus cornrow designs at our professional salon in Munster, Indiana. Call 219-276-6077 to book your appointment.

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder & Lead Braider
stylists.bio: The founder of OLUDAMI Braids built a professional braiding salon in Munster, Indiana around beauty, confidence, and excellence. From knotless and boho braids to detailed cornrow designs, every style is neat, polished, and made to turn heads.

reviews.name: Jasmine W.
reviews.text: My boho knotless braids are gorgeous! Neat parts, light on my scalp, and they lasted over a month.

reviews.name: Kiara T.
reviews.text: The swirl cornrow design was a work of art. Everyone kept asking where I got my hair done.

reviews.name: Brianna H.
reviews.text: Professional salon, on time, and super clean. Best braids I've had in Northwest Indiana.

reviews.name: Nicole A.
reviews.text: Got my daughter's cornrows done and she loved them. Gentle, patient, and so talented.

contact.address: 419 Ridge Rd, Second Floor, Suite B, Munster, IN 46321
